scope: Publish qualified parallel quadrature with immutable raw experiments and shared proof bindings.
limits: The GPU revision improvement does not establish comparable-quality CPU outperformance.
Atomic integral accumulation order changes; no bitwise global reduction guarantee.
Setup and transfer are excluded from warmed replay; setup and first calls are recorded separately.
Independent sampled surface distances are not Hausdorff certificates.
Exact previous geometry proofs transfer only through complete array/oriented-connectivity checks; current exports receive their own round trips.
reproduction: Use the pinned baseline/runtime sources, NVIDIA L40 and Warp 1.19.0+cu12. Preserve original .work/vtm paths or adapt copies of the retained scripts.

Use .venv/bin/python with PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 WARP_CACHE_PATH=/opt/warpower-generated-cache OPENBLAS_NUM_THREADS=1 OMP_NUM_THREADS=4 PYTHONPATH=.:.work/vtm. One GPU job; no heavy CPU work during clean timing.

Run private contracts/static/pilot qualification, then current production tests v2, final timing, native/memory qualification and the paired/frame checks. Do not overwrite historical or failed attempts.
Restore shared inputs/helpers/proof records from the linked prior evidence; native validators are documented in benchmarks/cpu/README.md.
The scanned input remains under the original Stanford/libigl provenance terms, not the repository MIT license.
